title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/campaign/warband-rating.yaml
description: The warband rating formula: which components add to it, how each one is applied and what is left out. The formula is rule knowledge; the computed rating of a concrete warband is derived campaign state and is never persisted here.

effect_ids.description: Effects of the formula a warband's own special rules may modify.

components.description: What the rating is made of.

exclusions.description: What the rating deliberately leaves out. Empty today: the source declares no exclusion, and the list is declared rather than implied so an exclusion is added as data, not as prose.

applies_to.description: What the component is counted over.

operation.description: `add_per_model` adds the value once per model of `applies_to`; `add_experience` adds the value once per accumulated Experience point.

note.description: Editorial clarification of the component, e.g. that a large creature is also worth its accumulated Experience.
